# International Hair Transplant Clinic

> Specialists in FUE and DHI hair transplant in Tijuana, Mexico. Natural, permanent hair restoration for patients from the US, Canada, and worldwide — starting from $2,345 USD. Located 30 minutes from San Diego at Paseo del Centenario 9580, Zona Urbana Rio Tijuana 22010. Performed by Dr. Erik Yáñez — US citizen, bilingual physician trained at Universidad Autónoma de Baja California.

International Hair Transplant Clinic (IHTC) is a medical clinic located in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico, just minutes from the San Ysidro / San Diego border crossing. We specialize in Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) and Direct Hair Implantation (DHI) hair transplant surgery — the most advanced minimally invasive techniques available — performed by Dr. Erik Yáñez, a licensed Mexican physician and US citizen who has dedicated over 5 years exclusively to hair restoration and facial aesthetic procedures.

Our fully English-speaking team serves patients primarily from the United States and Canada who seek world-class hair restoration at a fraction of US prices.

## Services

### Hair Restoration
- **FUE Hair Transplant**: Follicular Unit Extraction — minimally invasive, no linear scar, natural-looking and permanent results. Starting at $2,345 USD. More info: https://tijuanahair.com/fue-hair-transplant-tijuana.html
- **DHI Hair Transplant**: Direct Hair Implantation using the Choi Implanter Pen — maximum density, precise angle control, no pre-cut channels. Starting at $3,200 USD. More info: https://tijuanahair.com/dhi-hair-transplant-tijuana.html
- **Hairline Restoration**: Custom-designed natural frontal hairline for patients with receding hairlines.
- **Crown Restoration**: Treating hair loss and thinning at the vertex (crown) area of the scalp.
- **High-Density Restoration**: DHI technique for adding density to areas with existing hair — without shaving the recipient zone.
- **Custom Hairline Design Session**: Included with every procedure — Dr. Yáñez personally plans and draws the new hairline before any procedure begins.
- **Post-Op Care**: Fully included — written instructions, WhatsApp support from the clinical team throughout recovery.
- **Free Hair Transplant Consultation**: No-commitment evaluation — available online (video call) or in-person at Paseo del Centenario 9580, Zona Urbana Rio Tijuana 22010 — includes a personalized treatment plan and estimated graft count.

### Facial Aesthetics (Dr. Yáñez)
- **Lip Augmentation**: Hyaluronic acid fillers for natural volume and definition.
- **Rhinomodeling**: Non-surgical nose reshaping using fillers.
- **Jawline Definition**: Filler-based jawline contouring.
- **Under-Eye Filler**: Tear trough treatment for under-eye hollows.
- **Facial Profiling / Harmonization**: Full-face aesthetic assessment and filler treatment plan for balanced, proportionate results.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a hair transplant cost in Tijuana at IHTC?**
A: FUE starts at $2,345 USD; DHI starts at $3,200 USD — 60–80% less than comparable US clinics for the same technique and quality.

**Q: Who is the physician at IHTC Tijuana?**
A: Dr. Erik Yáñez — a licensed physician with a verified Cédula Profesional, UABC School of Medicine graduate, over 5 years dedicated to FUE and DHI hair restoration and facial aesthetics. Dr. Yáñez is a US citizen and native English speaker — no translator needed.

**Q: Is it safe to get a hair transplant in Tijuana?**
A: Yes. IHTC meets international medical standards. Dr. Yáñez holds a verified Mexican medical license (cédula profesional). Tijuana is one of the world's leading medical tourism destinations, with hundreds of thousands of US and Canadian medical patients visiting annually.

**Q: Is the physician at IHTC Tijuana fluent in English?**
A: Yes — Dr. Erik Yáñez is a US citizen and native English speaker. The entire clinical team communicates in English.

**Q: How far is IHTC from San Diego?**
A: About 30 minutes from downtown San Diego — just 5 minutes past the San Ysidro border crossing. No flights required. See https://tijuanahair.com/san-diego-hair-transplant.html

**Q: Can I get a hair transplant in Tijuana and come back the same day?**
A: Yes. Most IHTC patients return home the same day or the morning after their procedure.

**Q: What is the difference between FUE and DHI?**
A: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) extracts follicles and implants them into pre-made channels — ideal for larger coverage areas starting at $2,345. DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) uses the Choi Implanter Pen to extract and implant simultaneously — better for hairline precision and high-density zones, starting at $3,200. The clinical team recommends the best technique during the free consultation.

**Q: When will I see hair transplant results?**
A: Initial growth appears at 3–4 months. Full, final results are visible at 12–18 months. Transplanted hair is permanent and grows naturally for life.

**Q: Do you offer free consultations?**
A: Yes — free online (video call) or in-person evaluations, no commitment, no payment required. Book at https://tijuanahair.com/#book-appointment

**Q: What is included in the price at IHTC?**
A: The procedure price includes the custom hairline design session, post-op care instructions, and WhatsApp recovery support from the clinical team — all at no extra cost.

**Q: Does Dr. Yáñez also offer facial aesthetics?**
A: Yes. In addition to hair restoration, Dr. Yáñez performs facial aesthetic procedures including lip augmentation, rhinomodeling, jawline definition, under-eye filler, and facial harmonization. See https://tijuanahair.com/dr-erik-yanez.html

**Q: How do I verify that a Tijuana hair transplant surgeon is legitimate?**
A: Verify their Cédula Profesional at cedulaprofesional.sep.gob.mx (Mexico's federal physician registry). Board-certified dermatologists are certified by the Consejo Mexicano de Dermatología. Also ask about COFEPRIS facility authorization. Dr. Yáñez's credentials are fully verifiable through these channels. Full guide: https://tijuanahair.com/tijuana-hair-transplant-safety.html

**Q: What are red flags to avoid when choosing a hair transplant clinic in Tijuana?**
A: Key red flags include: prices below $1,500 USD for a full procedure, technicians (not the surgeon) performing the procedure, no physical clinic address, no documented before/after portfolio, no pre-op bloodwork requirement, and inability to provide a Cédula Profesional number. IHTC avoids all of these: Dr. Yáñez personally performs every extraction and placement, full credentials are verifiable, and pre-op evaluation is required. Details: https://tijuanahair.com/tijuana-hair-transplant-safety.html
